description: Remind Claude to perform Knowledge Graph retrieval and synchronization on every user turn.

hooks.command: echo "Knowledge Graph continuous-memory policy: On this turn, search the knowledge-graph MCP before reasoning from prior user/project context. Complete the user's task. Before finishing, follow the knowledge-management skill to persist decisions and precise user/project facts; if none exist, use the minimal monthly interaction journal fallback. Never store universal facts as user knowledge or invent personal facts. Do not reorganize or delete unless explicitly asked."
